lifetime: Monotonic non-reused handle; close withdraws lookup and joins accepted calls before encoder release. Text/output spans are caller-owned until the synchronous call returns.
output: One u64 ordinary-token count per UTF-8 text in original order; failed calls leave output unchanged; special token spellings are ordinary text.
authority: Pure token measurement; no model selection, account, billing, user/tenant store, fallback or execution rights.
